verdict.rationale: Airweave is a context-retrieval layer for agents, so session-continuity summaries are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only documents syncing and searching external data sources (collections, vector and agentic search, MCP, CLI), not summarizing past agent sessions or threads. Searching synced app data such as Slack is a related feature, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off
